Haha, that barbecue place yesterday was amazing, and the boss gave us a free plate of lamb skewers. Is anyone going hiking today? The forecast says it'll be a bit cloudy in the afternoon but probably no rain. Can someone bring a camera? I want to take some photos for my moments and fill in the group photo from last time. Also a reminder: pay your group fee before Sunday, Xiao Wang in finance says we're tallying it this time. Thanks everyone!

Long time no see! For the class reunion we agreed on, everyone seems free, so let's make it the second Saturday of next month. I've thought of a few venues, I'll put up a poll later. Does anyone still remember our homeroom teacher Mr. Wang's number? I'd like to invite him, but I searched my contacts and couldn't find it. If anyone has his contact, DM me, thanks! I'm saving a spot here, don't forget to sign up.

Just saw a set of night photos, the lighting is excellent. Does anyone know what lens was used? I'm on a standard lens and my shots always feel a bit off. If anyone's free this weekend, we could shoot by the river with tripods and try slower shutter speeds. Also, check the tide times in advance so we don't waste a trip.

Dear parents, the children are visiting the science museum on Wednesday. Things to bring: a water bottle, a jacket, and the student card. Bus fare has been collected. Could any parent take one more child? If so, reply in the group so we can arrange seats. Thanks for your support!

Forwarding: I heard that from tomorrow the west gate will be closed for construction, and all vehicles must enter and exit from the north gate, so please plan ahead. (Forwarded from a friend, not verified) Pass this on to relatives and friends quickly so they don't make a wasted trip. Apparently an insider at the property office said it; check the official notice for details. I've already sent it to three groups, no need to panic.

Forwarding: Good morning! Wishing you a good mood and smooth progress. The picture has been received, please forward it to the elders at home. Good news: for every ten people you forward it to, you'll win a red envelope! Share it quickly or you'll miss out. Wishing everyone good health and good fortune! I've forwarded it to twenty people and haven't received a red envelope yet, try it too, and remember to save the picture.

Forwarding an important notice: apparently unidentified people have been knocking on doors to sell things nearby, so please keep an eye on children and elderly people and don't open the door carelessly at night. (Not verified, do not spread unverified messages.) A neighbour says they saw two strangers in black jackets at building 3, so please keep watch.

Forwarding a health article to everyone: drinking eight glasses of warm water a day will lower blood pressure and cure insomnia. The title is catchy, but I couldn't find the source, so just take a look. The weekend book sharing goes ahead as planned, same place on the third floor of the community room. If anyone at home has high blood pressure, ask a doctor first and don't stop medication on your own.

Dear residents: this Saturday at 9:00 am we're holding a waste-sorting awareness event in the central garden, families with children are welcome. Eco bags and small gifts will be handed out on site. Also, from next Wednesday the lift will be serviced and out of use for two hours, so please travel at off-peak times. Thanks for your cooperation! Sign-up closes Friday evening, places are limited.

gloss_title: School district parents group - Teacher Lin
gloss_text: Dear parents, next Monday the school holds a parents' meeting at 15:30 in lecture hall 2 of the teaching building. It covers the end-of-term revision plan and holiday timetable, so please arrive on time if you can. If you have a special situation, tell the class teacher in advance, thank you. After the meeting we will share how to view report cards, so parents who need it should keep this message.

Meet this Sunday at 8:30 am at the community park for a two-hour river-cleaning volunteer activity. Bring your own gloves and water cup; bags will be provided on site. Friends who have signed up, please reply Signed Up in the group so we can count people, thanks! A simple lunch follows the activity, so we can eat and chat together.

[Emergency alert] Due to heavy rain, some roads in this area may flood. Avoid low-lying areas immediately, and do not drive through water. If you're in danger call 110 or 119 and wait on higher ground for rescue. Do not go to the riverside or underground car parks, and watch for further official updates.

URGENT: there is a gas leak in building 3. The gas company has been notified and is on its way. All residents must close the gas valve now, open windows for ventilation, do not use open flames or switch electrical appliances, and gather at the community square as soon as possible. Please follow this exactly, and help make sure elderly people and children are informed.

URGENT: the buildings on the east side of the community are being evacuated because of a fire. Residents of buildings 1 to 6 must leave immediately by the evacuation route for the north square, do not use the lifts, and do not go back inside for belongings. Firefighters are on site, please follow the instructions of staff there. If anyone is trapped, report it at once by calling 119.

Visitor notice: your visitor Mr. Zhang has reached the east gate and is being registered through the access system, expected to finish in 3 minutes. He is carrying a cardboard parcel, which the gate guard has collected. When you have time, confirm in the app whether he should come up. If not, you can simply decline this registration, and the gate will record it.

The gate camera has detected a courier waiting to be let in; he says he is delivering fresh groceries. You can view the live feed in the app and choose whether to let him in. If no action is taken, this notice will close automatically in five minutes, and the parcel will stay in the designated locker by the gate.

Your home's visitor log has been updated: two visitors entered the community this afternoon, a removal company worker and a property maintenance technician, and both are registered. You can see the full record on your device, and contact the property office if you have questions. This is a routine reminder and needs no immediate action.
